name: ezetta
description: A desktop app for writing long academic texts in Typst.
author: Felix Schorn

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:design && npm run check:notices && npm test
scripts.package: electron-vite build && node scripts/package-resources.mjs && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac-x64: electron-vite build && node scripts/package-resources.mjs && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: electron-vite build && node scripts/package-resources.mjs && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: electron-vite build && node scripts/package-resources.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:gallery: vite build --config vite.gallery.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.gallery.config.ts
scripts.gallery:app: vite build --config vite.gallery.config.ts && GALLERY_SHOW=1 electron tests/gallery/shell.mjs
